biggest_catch: You must be a Veteran 18+ with both PTSD and a sleep apnea diagnosis, and the study requires 8 treatment sessions over a year at VA Palo Alto.
catches: Must be a Veteran 18+ with diagnosed PTSD and sleep apnea; phone screen plus in-person screening required.
Random assignment to cognitive behavioral therapy or an education-based treatment group.
$340 only for completing all sessions; 8 sessions span a full year.
Reimbursement is for time; compensation varies by completion.

steps: Call the study staff at 650-849-0482 to begin screening.
Complete a phone screen for initial eligibility.
Be randomly assigned to cognitive behavioral therapy or an education-based treatment group.
Attend weekly sessions for four weeks, then sessions every three months, for a total of 8 sessions over one year.
Receive reimbursement of up to $340 for completing all sessions.
timing: Phone screen, in-person screening visit, and 8 individual treatment sessions over the course of one year.
